values.en: Take witnesses $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to X$ and $u:Y\to Z$, $v:Z\to Y$. Use $u\circ f$ and $g\circ v$. Composition preserves homotopy: pre- and postcomposition act on a homotopy by continuous composition. Hence $(g\circ v)\circ(u\circ f)\simeq g\circ\mathrm{id}_Y\circ f\simeq\mathrm{id}_X$, using $v\circ u\simeq\mathrm{id}_Y$ and $g\circ f\simeq\mathrm{id}_X$. Likewise $(u\circ f)\circ(g\circ v)\simeq u\circ\mathrm{id}_Y\circ v\simeq\mathrm{id}_Z$. Associativity and the identity laws identify the intermediate maps; transitivity of map homotopy joins the homotopies. Both composite maps are continuous.
values.zh-CN: 取见证 $f:X\to Y$、$g:Y\to X$ 及 $u:Y\to Z$、$v:Z\to Y$，令正向映射为 $u\circ f$，反向映射为 $g\circ v$。同伦可与连续映射前后复合，且仍联合连续。因此由 $v\circ u\simeq\mathrm{id}_Y$ 及 $g\circ f\simeq\mathrm{id}_X$ 得 $(g\circ v)\circ(u\circ f)\simeq g\circ\mathrm{id}_Y\circ f\simeq\mathrm{id}_X$。同理由另两条同伦律得 $(u\circ f)\circ(g\circ v)\simeq u\circ\mathrm{id}_Y\circ v\simeq\mathrm{id}_Z$。复合结合律和恒等律识别中间映射，映射同伦的传递性拼合各段同伦。两个复合映射都连续。
